###############################################################################

Make_Venne_Diagramme <- function(prefix, physeq_file) {
  
  physeq_clean <- readRDS(physeq_file)
  
  # Vérifications
  if (!inherits(physeq_clean, "phyloseq")) {
    stop("L'objet lu n'est pas un objet phyloseq.")
  }
  
  sam_df <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_clean))
  
  if (!"Category" %in% colnames(sam_df)) {
    stop("La colonne 'Category' est absente de sample_data(physeq_clean).")
  }
  
  # Delete sample without Category
  sam_df <- sam_df[!is.na(sam_df$Category), , drop = FALSE]
  physeq_clean <- prune_samples(rownames(sam_df), physeq_clean)
  
  # OTU Table
  otu <- as(otu_table(physeq_clean), "matrix")
  
  # Adding taxa in line names
  if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_clean)) {
    otu <- t(otu)
  }
  
  # Force order
  categories <- c("Native", "Invasive")
  
  if (!all(categories %in% unique(as.character(sam_df$Category)))) {
    stop("Les catégories 'Native' et 'Invasive' doivent être présentes dans sample_data.")
  }
  
  # Build set
  venn_sets <- lapply(categories, function(cat) {
    samples_cat <- rownames(sam_df)[sam_df$Category == cat]
    
    if (length(samples_cat) == 0) {
      return(character(0))
    }
    
    rownames(otu)[rowSums(otu[, samples_cat, drop = FALSE] > 0) > 0]
  })
  
  names(venn_sets) <- categories
  
  native_set   <- venn_sets$Native
  invasive_set <- venn_sets$Invasive
  
  total_otus    <- length(union(native_set, invasive_set))
  native_only   <- length(setdiff(native_set, invasive_set))
  invasive_only <- length(setdiff(invasive_set, native_set))
  shared_otus   <- length(intersect(native_set, invasive_set))
  
  # Venn object without labels
  venn_obj <- VennDiagram::draw.pairwise.venn(
    area1 = length(native_set),
    area2 = length(invasive_set),
    cross.area = shared_otus,
    
    category = c("", ""),
    
    fill = c("#9ecae1", "#f4a6a6"),
    alpha = c(0.7, 0.7),
    col = c("black", "black"),
    lwd = 2,
    lty = "solid",
    
    cex = 1.6,
    fontface = "plain",
    
    rotation.degree = 0,
    euler.d = FALSE,
    scaled = FALSE,
    ind = FALSE
  )
  
  # Convert to ggplot with added labels in venn diagramm circles
  venn_plot <- ggplotify::as.ggplot(function() {
    grid::grid.draw(venn_obj)
    
    grid::grid.text(
      "Native",
      x = 0.33, y = 0.72,
      gp = grid::gpar(col = "#3182bd", fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold")
    )
    
    grid::grid.text(
      "Invasive",
      x = 0.67, y = 0.72,
      gp = grid::gpar(col = "#de2d26", fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold")
    )
  }) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(prefix, " (Total OTUs = ", total_otus, ")")
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  
  # Final object
  out <- list(
    prefix = prefix,
    physeq = physeq_clean,
    venn_sets = venn_sets,
    total_otus = total_otus,
    counts = c(
      Native_only   = native_only,
      Shared        = shared_otus,
      Invasive_only = invasive_only
    ),
    venn_plot = venn_plot
  )
  
  return(out)
}

# Apply

Venne_16s <- Make_Venne_Diagramme(
  prefix      = "Bacteria 16S",
  physeq_file = "Phyloseq_with_tree_16S.rds"
)

Venne_ITS <- Make_Venne_Diagramme(
  prefix      = "Fungi ITS",
  physeq_file = "Clean_phyloseq_OL4.rds"
)



combined_plot <- Venne_16s$venn_plot + Venne_ITS$venn_plot
combined_plot


ggsave(
  filename = "Venn_Comparison.png",
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
